integrity: The multiplicity obstruction is a symbolic construction of one arrangement with an exact nonreal eigenvalue. The included checker only cross-checks the algebra and packing inequality; it is not used to infer the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for exactly two distinct nonzero entry values and dimensions \(n\ge4\). Dimension \(3\), three-or-more-valued multisets, and the Diophantine solution set of the one-exception square conditions are not classified here.
title: Fully nonzero two-valued PSI multisets in dimensions at least four have a unique exceptional entry
